LESSON: HEALTHY HABITS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health Practices
Topic 1.1: Healthy habits

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Healthy habits. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify health habits that prevent illnesses,
2. state the importance of practicing health habits to promote wellbeing of self and others,
3. practise health habits that promote wellbeing,
4. appreciate the importance of practising health habits to promote wellbeing of self and others. keep a simple journal on health habits they have observed.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify health habits that prevent illnesses,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify health habits that prevent illnesses,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. state the importance of practicing health habits to promote wellbeing of self and others,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state the importance of practicing health habits to promote wellbeing of self and others,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. practise health habits that promote wellbeing,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practise health habits that promote wellbeing,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the importance of practising health habits to promote wellbeing of self and others. keep a simple journal on health habits they have observed.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of practising health habits to promote wellbeing of self and others. keep a simple journal on health habits they have observed. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Healthy habits.
2. Explain Healthy habits to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healthy habits.
4. Show that you can: identify health habits that prevent illnesses,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healthy habits. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Healthy habits important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify health habits that prevent illnesses,
2. state the importance of practicing health habits to promote wellbeing of self and others,
3. practise health habits that promote wellbeing,
4. appreciate the importance of practising health habits to promote wellbeing of self and others. keep a simple journal on health habits they have observed.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
